name: Wealth Playground
tag: One command center for a consulting business and sustainable container home projects.

scenarios.title: Forecast consulting revenue
scenarios.ask: I have {proposals} open proposals averaging ${deal} and win about {win}. What does next quarter look like?
steps: Pipeline agent
Read {proposals} sample proposals with amounts and expected close dates.
Forecast agent
Weighted each by the {win} win rate.
Follow-up agent
Flagged {=max(1, round(proposals * 0.3))} proposals with no contact in 14 days.
Dashboard
Added the forecast to the command center next to the container projects.
followups: How can I raise the forecast fastest?
Follow up on the {=max(1, round(proposals * 0.3))} quiet proposals first. Stale proposals are the most common reason deals slip.
Can it share cash with the container projects?
It shows both side by side so you can see when consulting income can fund a build phase, without mixing the books.

scenarios.title: Budget a container home
scenarios.ask: Budget a {containers}-container home with a {finish} finish and ${site} in site work.
steps: Shell estimator
Priced {containers} sample containers with cutting and framing: ${=containers * 9000}.
Finish estimator
Added insulation, electrical, plumbing and interior at a {finish} level: ${=round(containers * 30000 * finish)}.
Site estimator
Included ${site} for foundation, utilities and permits.
Green options
Listed solar, rainwater and spray insulation add-ons.
followups: Container builds often meet surprises in permits and site prep. A 10% buffer, about ${=round((containers * 9000 + containers * 30000 * finish + site) * 0.1)} here, keeps the project moving.
These are sample prices. Enter quotes from your builders and the budget updates.

scenarios.title: Weekly owner review
scenarios.ask: Give me my weekly review across {clients} consulting clients and {builds} active builds.
steps: Client agent
Checked deliverables and hours for {clients} clients.
Build agent
Checked milestones and spending for {builds} builds.
Cash agent
Listed invoices due and build payments coming up.
Writer
Wrote a one-page review with the top 3 decisions for the week.
followups: Can it send the review to my phone?
Yes. It can arrive by email or as a pinned note every Monday morning.
Anything that needs your approval: a change order, a proposal price or a late invoice to chase.
